we have demonstrated a highly efficient LED-based optical wireless downlink system, capable of providing Ethernet 10BASET communications over a distance 2.3m, using commercial white light LEDs.

a highly efficient and a high luminous light-emitting diodetunable white LED visible light communication (VLC) system has been demonstrated for standard room illumination levels, which is capable to provide wide-coverage Ethernet optical wireless downlink communication with an error-free performance over a distance of up to 2.3 meters.

the design and development of a compact and efficient visible light communications system for use in indoor applications, and it is the first to demonstrate a fully functional Ethernet system using commercially available white phosphor LEDs.
the development of a novel and efficient LED-based optical wireless communications system for the delivery of high-speed data and multimedia applications in the home and office environment.
the design, development, and experimental demonstration of an efficient, low-cost, and compact Ethernet optical wireless downlink using commercial white phosphor LEDs.
